test_description: Histogram sum invariance — compare NLL and MAP fit on identical empirical PMFs with total counts W=1000 vs W=10000
input_contract: 16-bin uint32_t count histograms with identical relative frequencies
independent_oracle: With prior_lambda_=0, NLL(10*H) == 10 * NLL(H) to floating-point precision; with fixed prior_lambda_=0.04, tether weight scales as 1/W

expected.scale_relation: Per-round normalized NLL is scale-invariant (NLL_10k == NLL_1k); orbit RMSE between W=1000 and W=10000 fits < 0.005
